the study of the developmental pattern of malate-asparate shuttle enzymes during post-natal development of mice.
the hormonal control of malate-asparate shuttle enzymes in liver and kidney during postnatal development in mice.
the hormonal regulation of malic enzyme and other key metabolic enzymes during postnatal growth of mice.

the hormonal control of these enzymes is not only tissue-specific but is also dependent on the developmental stage of animals.

hydrocortisones regulate the activity of malate-aspatate shuttle enzymes in the liver and kidneys of 15-,30- and 50-day old mice.

the malate-aspartrate shuttle is a highly regulated metabolic pathway that is controlled by a complex set of factors including hormones, growth factors, and developmental cues.
